# ImportNotice

**Class** · namespace `VRFramework.Core.Editors.SceneBuilding` · assembly `VRFramework.Core.Editors` · [view source](https://git.cie-group.cz/vr-framework/vrf4/core/-/blob/main/Editor/SceneBuilder/UI/ImportNotice.cs#L11)

A notice in the Scene view for as long as a dropped asset is still on its way. Downloading an
asset from a library takes a while, and without this nothing shows between the drop and the
object appearing.
